liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Sugaree** (2 reviews): The reviewer describes the Sugaree performance as smoking; Bruce Hornsby played accordion for Sugaree and Memphis Blues [9][18]
- **Throwing Stones** (1 review): Reviewer calls the Throwing Stones performance one of the funkier versions they have heard [9]
- **Terrapin Station** (1 review): Reviewer finds the sequence from Terrapin through The Other One incredible [10]

## Setlist highlights

- **gd88-06-25 s1t01 Crowd**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [20]
- **gd88-06-25 s1t02 Feel Like A Stranger**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [20]
- **gd88-06-25 s1t03 Franklin's Tower**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [20]
- **gd88-06-25 s1t04 Box Of Rain**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [20]
- **gd88-06-25 s1t05 Sugaree**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [20]
- **gd88-06-25 s1t06 Stuck Inside Of Mobile With The Memphis Blues Again**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [20]
- **gd88-06-25 s1t07 West LA Fadeaway**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [20]
- **gd88-06-25 s1t08 Cassidy**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [20]

## The recordings

- **gd1988-06-25.143077.fob.schoeps.mk2s.dalton.miller.clugston.flac1644** (recommended): audience recording; 22 songs; 161 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1988-06-25.163475.senn.me80.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 20 songs; 159 min [2]
- **gd1988-06-25.senn421.zaleski-kolodjeski.ford.107387.flac16**: source not stated; 20 songs; 161 min; rated 4.14/5 by 7 [4]
- **gd88-06-25.schoeps-fob.unknown.8478.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 19 songs; 163 min; rated 3.43/5 by 28 [5]. Said about its sound: Reviewer notes a nice recording from a difficult place with huge venue ambiance; Reviewer notes the music sounds eerily similar to the previous night's performance [12][19]
- **gd1988-06-25.149261.fob.unkown.ebel.flac1644**: source not stated; 20 songs; 164 min [7]. Said about its sound: Reviewer notes the recording lacks the constant screaming person found on other tapes [7]

## Around the show

- Band arrived by helicopter due to interstate traffic; wind cooled the crowd before the show [8]
- Bruce Hornsby played accordion on Sugaree and Queen Jane [8]
- Second set opened with early versions of Built to Last songs [10]
- Band informed audience that not just anyone plays accordion with them [11]
- Vending and camping were everywhere in the large parking lot [11]
- Traveler drove from Winchester, VA, finding the trip worth it despite the heat [12]
- Drought and Dead High pressure parked over Hebron caused brutal heat [13]
- Attendee took too many no-doze, resulting in four days without sleep [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1988-06-25.143077.fob.schoeps.mk2s.dalton.miller.clugston.flac1644**: taped by Tim Dalton; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Master (FOB) Audience PCM; Schoeps MK2S split omnis > Tim Dalton's PCM clone (16-bit/44.1k); Transfer Info: PCM (Sony SL-10)> Sony PCM-601ESD > Behringer… [1]
- **gd1988-06-25.163475.senn.me80.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Michael Hessberg; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Michael Hessberg's Master Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser ME80 mics > Sony D5M [2]. Also: Schoeps CMC4 MK41 source supplied a 0:28 patch in Drums [2]
- **gd1988-06-25.senn421.zaleski-kolodjeski.ford.107387.flac16**: taped by Lucien Zaleski and Andrew Kolodjeski; transferred by Alex Ford; source: Sennheiser 421s> Sony D5> Sony D5> MAC [4]. Also: Shnid 8478 used to patch tape flips and the encore pause [4]
- **gd88-06-25.schoeps-fob.unknown.8478.sbeok.shnf**: source: Schoeps MK2s fob [5]
- **gd1988-06-25.149261.fob.unkown.ebel.flac1644**: taped by Unknown; transferred by Pete Ebel; source: FOB Microphones Unknown-> PCM-> DAT [7]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Robbi Cohn: [1988-06-25 Buckeye Lake Music Center, Hebron, OH, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1988-06-25-buckeye-lake-music-center-hebron-oh-usa/) [21]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Buckeye Lake Music Center - June 25, 1988](https://www.dead.net/show/june-25-1988) [22]
